4. [LDET.11.4] **Internal randomness is fixed-seed.** The one place randomness appears internally
   — the `sample <n>` reservoir
   time model ([LSMP]) — uses a
   **fixed-seed integer PRNG** (`xorshift64`, seed
   `0x9e3779b97f4a7c15`, advanced once per absorbed sample in
   event-trace order). That is a deterministic function of the input
   sequence — the seed-from-event-trace discipline this clause
   requires — and pure 64-bit integer arithmetic, so it is
   cross-platform bit-exact. Wall-clock or entropy-pool seeding would violate this
   guarantee.
